messages.subject: [rkward-users] Update 0.5: how to get the old shortcuts?
messages.subject_clean: [rkward-users] Update 0.5: how to get the old shortcuts?
messages.body_plain:
Hello

Last week, the KDE version in the repository for Ubuntu 8.04 came from 
3.4 to 4.0.5, so RKward was updated to 0.5. The change made some minor 
problems:

-the shortcuts are differents... if I remember well,  could use F8, F9 
and F10 for run line/selection/all and now it changed, one needs Shift + 
F8, F9 and F10... Am I right? And there was also the shortcut Shift + L 
for run line... I did not find a way to configure it in the old 
fashion... is there a possibility?

-the icons in the toolbar for th are too large to be all displayed (this 
may come from the french version where "run all" becomes "lancer la 
ligne courante") so I can't see them all. Can I configure how they are 
displayed?

Thank you!!
